description: Research TikTok Shop products, categories, creators, videos, and live commerce with EchoTik data.

fields.label: API Username
fields.description: EchoTik API username used for HTTP Basic authentication. Create or view the credential pair at https://echotik.live/platform/api-keys.

fields.label: API Password
fields.description: EchoTik API password paired with the API username. Create or view the credential pair at https://echotik.live/platform/api-keys.

actions.name: get_category_overview

gmv30Days.description: Category GMV during the latest 30-day window.

totalSales.description: Cumulative category product sales estimated by EchoTik.

sales1Day.description: Category product sales during the latest one-day window.

sales7Days.description: Category product sales during the latest seven-day window.

sales30Days.description: Category product sales during the latest 30-day window.

totalProducts.description: Total products collected for the category.

products1Day.description: Products added during the latest one-day window.

products7Days.description: Products added during the latest seven-day window.

products30Days.description: Products added during the latest 30-day window.
